messages:
sara: Quick sync — we need final alignment for the marketplace listing + partner press timing. Cloud vendor needs our asset + test account by EOD Wed. Can folks confirm ownership?
omar: I can own press/blog coordination. What embargo window are we aiming for?
liz: From product side: we need the landing page copy, 2 screenshots, and verified logos. Also need SSO testing completed before listing goes live.
ben: Eng: we have a smoke test for the marketplace flow. Will run on Mon; need a partner test account + sample model artifact.
sara: @omar target embargo = Thu 11am PT ideally. That lets us land docs + landing page Wed night. Is that OK? :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
omar: Thu 11am PT works if we have final assets by Wed 3pm. I’ll draft the blog and press quote now.
press-bot: Scheduled press embargo reminder set for 2034670000 (Thu 11:00 PT).
liz: Checklist item — marketing needs hero image (1200x600), 1 short demo gif (max 6s), and the verified partner logo (SVG). Also add a short customer quote placeholder.
sara: Ben — can you paste the smoke test command so partners can try it locally?
ben: Sure — use this to validate token exchange + inference:
```
curl -X POST https://marketplace.example.com/api/v1/validate \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer TEST_PARTNER_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-small","input":"hello"}'
```
ben: If that returns 200 + "ok": true we’re good. Share test token with partner ops.
omar: I’ll own the blog draft and send copy by Tue EOD. Can someone review tone + technical accuracy Wed morning?
liz: I’ll review product accuracy. @sara can you do final signoff on partner mentions and legal-safe phrasing Wed afternoon?
sara: Yep, will sign off Wed by 2pm. Also can we run a dry-run publish in staging Wed 5pm to catch any rendering issues?
ben: Yes, we’ll run the staging dry-run and capture screenshots. Please @mention me when assets land.
sara: Great — action items: Omar = blog & press copy, Ben = smoke test + staging dry-run, Liz = landing assets + logo verification, Sara = partner/legal signoff. Ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
